source:
@@U04037@@
I pity him; he was an honest, good man.

@@U04039@@
Come, let’s take a look. Where there’s life, there’s hope. Let’s free him from this narrow valley. Save him this once, he'll have no further worries. Who knows how the dice will fall? And if luck is with him, he'll soon have a proper following. (They cross the lower range of mountains and look down upon the deployment of the army in the valley. Drums and martial music rise from below.)

@@U04041@@
Their position is well chosen. Come, we'll join them. Their victory then is secure.

@@U04043@@
What’s the point of all this? Trickery! Deception! Illusion!

@@U04045@@
The point is to win battles— military cunning known as stratagems. Be secure in your great designs and keep an eye on your own purpose. If we manage to save this Emperor's throne and country, you will kneel as his feet to receive the boundless shoreline in fief.

@@U04047@@
Since there isn’t much you haven't done so far, let’s see you win a battle. Show me how.
translation:
@@U04037@@
我可怜他；他是一个诚实的好人。

@@U04039@@
来，我们来看一下。哪里有生命，哪里就有希望。让我们把他从这个狭窄的山谷中解救出来。救他一次，他就没有后顾之忧了。谁知道骰子会怎样落下？如果运气好的话，他很快就会拥有一批忠实的追随者。 （越过低山，俯视山谷中的大军部署，鼓乐军乐从下而起。）

@@U04041@@
他们的位置选择得很好。来吧，我们加入他们。那么他们的胜利就稳了。

@@U04043@@
这一切有什么意义呢？诡计！欺骗！错觉！

@@U04045@@
关键是要赢得战斗——军事上的狡猾被称为谋略。确保你的伟大设计并关注你自己的目的。如果我们能保住本皇的皇位和国家，你们就跪在他的脚下，接受无边无际的海岸线封地。

@@U04047@@
既然到目前为止你还没有做太多事情，那就让我们看看你赢得一场战斗吧。告诉我怎么做。
